lines.en: I hop through the grass in small steps.
I stop each step and look around.
I cross a patch of wet grass.
I walk a circle around a stone.
I shuffle slowly toward you.

lines.zh: 我四只小蹄踩得草叶乱晃。
lines.en: My four little hooves set the grass swaying.
I tuck my legs and hop the shallow ditch.
I keep low as I move.

lines.zh: 走两步，我回头确认你在。
lines.en: Two steps on, I look back to check you're there.
I walk slowly along the slope.
The fallen leaves are crisp and crackle underfoot.
I head for the tree shadow.

lines.zh: 我从一丛草跳到另一丛。
lines.en: I hop from one tuft to the next.

lines.zh: 我踩着田埂边的软土走。
lines.en: I walk the soft soil beside the field ridge.
I lower my head and sniff roots.
I turn a corner by the stone.
I crouch in the grass, still.
I slowly chew some grass.
I raise my head to the sky.

lines.zh: 一片叶子落下，我耳朵转了转。
lines.en: A leaf falls; my ear swivels.
The grass on this slope has just sprouted.
The sun's still low; I'll wait a while longer.
I huddle without moving.
Wind presses the grass against me.

lines.zh: 我张开小嘴，打了个哈欠。
lines.en: I open my small mouth and yawn.
My kind are grazing over there.
I lift my nose and sniff the wind.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己小小的影子。
lines.en: I look down at my own small shadow.
I settle into lying down.
I stand up and stretch a little.
It's quiet now.

lines.zh: 我转身朝风来的那边站。
lines.en: I turn to face where the wind comes from.
You've bent down to look at me.
I look at you, head aslant.
Your hand is big; I don't flinch.
I bleat, softly.
You stand like a tree.

lines.zh: 打死我，掉出来的也叫奇普。
lines.en: Kill me, and what drops is also called Cheep.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻你的鞋，名字就是这么来的。
lines.en: I sniffed your boot; that is where my name came from.

lines.zh: 你身上有草的味道，你弯下腰了。
lines.en: You smell of grass, and you have bent down.

lines.zh: 我这名字，就是掉落的那件东西。
lines.en: My name is the very item I drop.

lines.zh: 我仰头看你，草屑还挂着。
lines.en: I look up at you, grass bits still on me.
I'm not very afraid of people.
Lower your head a bit.
I bleat and leap away.
I dive into the grass.
Grass bits are in the wound and it itches.
I duck behind that stone.
I shake off the grass bits.
I push myself up on four short legs.

lines.zh: 草坡上的同伴全跑光了。
lines.en: Every fellow on the slope has bolted.
I take a few slow breaths.
I quietly note your smell.
I hide behind the slope.
Is that grass? Let me see.
I'll come running.
This grass smells newly cut.

lines.zh: 我小口小口嚼着你给的草。
lines.en: I nibble the grass you gave me, bite by bite.
Bring a little more; I'll eat it.
I chew and steal a look at you.
A few bites and it's gone.
Finished, I come to your hand.

lines.zh: 你的指缝里留着草汁味。
lines.en: Grass juice still clings between your fingers.
When you crouch, I'm easier.
I eat by your foot.
This is tenderer than the wild.
Full, I lie down.
Thank you; I'll remember.
Will you bring more next time?

lines.zh: 我慢慢地舔着你的掌心。
lines.en: I lick your palm slowly.
One touch and I bolt into the grass.

lines.zh: 我还没你靴子高，撞不坏。
lines.en: I'm shorter than your boot; a bump won't hurt me.
I dart between your feet.

lines.zh: 你的鞋尖擦过我的背毛。
lines.en: Your boot toe brushes the fur on my back.
I hop half a step aside.

lines.zh: 奇普这么小，草却踩平了。
lines.en: Cheep is small, yet the grass is flattened.
I steady myself and keep grazing.
Your boot nearly pressed me flat.

lines.zh: 我小步在草丛里蹦，退到石后。
lines.en: I hop through the grass and back behind the stone.
That squeeze was nothing.
Another little one comes near.
We nuzzle noses.

lines.zh: 我叫奇普，名字就这么来的。
lines.en: They call me Cheep; that is the whole story.
Its coat is softer than mine.
Behind the grassy slope is private.
We lie down pressed together.

lines.zh: 风把我们吹得靠得更近。
lines.en: The wind presses us closer.
Its ear rests against me.
This meadow is enough for us.

lines.zh: 太阳落山了，我们还没走。
lines.en: The sun sets and we haven't left.
I pick it up and shake it.
Can I chew this?
I chew it slowly once.
Too hard; I spit it out.
I drag it into the grass.
I keep it by my mouth.
A fellow tried; I ran off.

lines.zh: 我把它拱进石头底下的洞。
lines.en: I nose it into the hollow beneath the stone.
It is slightly sweet.
I gulp it down.
There's tender grass over there.
I see it, just ahead.
I shuffle over, one step at a time.
That's something edible.
I've fixed on that clump.
I shift my four little hooves.
The shoot is just near.
I lower my head to look.
Good, that patch.
I'll go over and eat slowly.
I hop my way closer.
Eyes aslant, I watch you at every step.
The grass blocks my view.

lines.zh: 我贴着草根又挪近一寸。
lines.en: Hugging the grass roots, I inch closer.
It's beside the stone.
Now is the time to eat.

lines.zh: 我被杀之后，掉的就是我。
lines.en: When killed, what drops is me.
Half a step more and the grass is at my mouth.
Good, right here.
I start to bite.
I butt once.
I paw with a foreleg.
I bite the stem and tug.

lines.zh: 我的名字就是别人给的。
lines.en: Even my name was given by someone else.
I trip over my own feet.
I lower my head and eat again.
The grass tore away.
I toss my head.
I gave a shove; it was weak.
You didn't mind that at all.
The grass tips stir and I poke my head out.

lines.zh: 草籽挂在我背上，我甩甩。
lines.en: Grass seed clings to my back; I shake it off.
Cheep, standing on the grassy slope.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看这个世界。
lines.en: I raise my head to this world.
I bleat twice at the empty meadow.

lines.zh: 我绕过那块长青苔的石头。
lines.en: I come around the mossy stone.
The grass here is soft.

lines.zh: 奇普走到空地中央站住。
lines.en: Cheep walks to the clearing's center.

lines.zh: 我先啃了脚边最嫩的一丛。
lines.en: I nibble the tenderest tuft by my feet first.
I run to the other side.
The flames singe my coat.

lines.zh: 我一路滚到坡底的草里。
lines.en: I roll all the way into the grass at the slope's foot.

lines.zh: 水没到我的鼻子，我蹬得很急。
lines.en: Water reaches my nose and I kick hard.
A bang throws me off my feet.
An arrow whips past my ear tip.
The light sets my legs trembling.

lines.zh: 我的名字，就是我掉的东西。
lines.en: My name is what I drop.
Too close; I flatten and curl.
There's no grass here to eat.
